create_task: create a new task with a given name and task type using Task.new
get_task_runs: get all launched runs of a task using the Task.get_runs method
get_task_assignments: get all assignments for all runs of a task using Task.get_assignments
get_task_total_spend: calculate the total funding spent across all runs of a task using Task.get_total_spend
get_task_project: get the project associated with a task using the Task.get_project method
